title: Ensure all open comments are resolved before merging
description: Reviewer objections raised as tasks should not be mergeable away. Enforcing task completion turns review comments into something that has to be answered rather than outlived.
remediation: Repository settings -> Pull requests -> Merge checks: enable "All tasks resolved". Set it at Project settings -> Pull requests -> Merge checks to apply it project-wide.
fixSummary: Enable "All tasks resolved" at Repository settings -> Pull requests -> Merge checks.
